_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Twentieth scheduled run. 15 of 20 URLs served a catalog -- the four marketplace and social entries have no product feed and never serve one, and Flower Meadow Dream remains refused by this environment's egress proxy, as on every day since 2026-09-16. No new matches, no cases created, nothing held, nothing cut-roses-only. Several catalogs grew but none of the additions carries a chart name: Ergonzi 507->511, Hillside Rose Farm 155->156, Mola Rose and Muse Roses 760->761, Rose Explosion 1439->1440. Yesterday's three new cases all re-verified present on their first full day. 371 of 375 cases re-verified; the four unconfirmed are Flower Meadow Dream's 3 and HILLSIDERO-005, absent for a ninth run.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.

Not reached. Both www.myroseworld.com and myroseworld.com were refused by this environment's egress proxy at the CONNECT stage, so the request never reached the seller's server. This is our own network policy, not a block by the site. Unchanged since 2026-09-16. The site's 3 existing cases (MYROSEWORL-001..003) could not be re-verified and keep their 2026-09-16 Last Verified date.
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served normally at 156 products, up from 155. HILLSIDERO-005 (Darlington, Pending) is absent for a ninth consecutive run; its Last Verified stays at 2026-09-28.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.

screenshot_limitation: Still no case has a screenshot on file -- same network-proxy limitation as prior runs (headless Chromium cannot complete a connection through this environment's egress proxy). Explained to the user in chat on 2026-09-14; awaiting their choice of approach (manual capture vs. Wayback Machine vs. environment-level fix).
